guidance: Show, in a clearly-labeled illustrative way, how a Black Arrow system works (e.g. an automated lead follow-up sequence, missed-call text-back, review request flow).
evidence_note: Label as an example/demonstration. NEVER imply it is a specific client's live account or claim a performance result.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Demonstrations / System Walkthroughs' was the most under-served eligible category (target 10%, recent 7%).
post_rationale: Carousels/slideshows still lead B2B saves and depth, and the day-of-service text sequence (confirmation through review ask) is a genuinely unclaimed demonstration distinct from every prior pipeline, reminder, no-show, and review-gating system already shipped.

guidance: Honestly handle a common objection or hesitation an owner has about automation/marketing (cost, complexity, 'it feels impersonal'). Build trust. For done-for-you cost objections: never give numbers; the honest answer is that pricing follows a diagnosis meeting.
evidence_note: Transparent and honest; no unsupported guarantees, no done-for-you pricing.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Objection Handling / Audience Nurture' was the most under-served eligible category (target 6%, recent 3%).
post_rationale: Carousels still win saves/depth for B2B objection content, and the owner-bandwidth fear ('I don't have time to run another system') is a genuinely unclaimed objection distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, spam, adoption, migration, accuracy, shelfware, and desperate-reply objection already shipped.
